This report's code isn't R when it's prose: `f <- function() 1`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(R6)
summarise_sales <- function(df, by = "region") {
  aggregate(df$amount, list(df[[by]]), sum)
}
```

## Models

```{r models}
setClass("Sale", representation(amount = "numeric", region = "character"))
setGeneric("total", function(x, ...) standardGeneric("total"))
setMethod("total", "Sale", function(x, ...) sum(x@amount))

Ledger <- R6Class("Ledger",
  public = list(
    entries = NULL,
    add = function(sale) {
      self$entries <- c(self$entries, sale)
      invisible(self)
    },
    balance = function() sum(vapply(self$entries, total, numeric(1)))
  )
)
```
